## Problem

What gap exists in the framework today? Not "what should be added" — start with the problem.

## Proposed addition

Which layer does this belong to?

- [ ] Agent (`.kenovis/AI/agents/`)
- [ ] Workflow (`.kenovis/AI/workflows/`)
- [ ] Policy (`.kenovis/AI/policies/`)
- [ ] Command (`.kenovis/AI/commands/`)
- [ ] Template (`.kenovis/AI/templates/`)
- [ ] Something else (explain)

## Why it's framework-level, not product-level

Explain why this is reusable across any product built on the AI-OS, not specific to one business. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Alternatives considered

Does an existing agent/workflow/policy/command already cover this, even partially?
